# NoCollisionConstraint

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")`

Stops two specific parts from colliding with each other. Both still collide with everything else. Use it where a collision group is too broad, since a group applies to every part in it: an object and the character carrying it, or a door and its frame.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the two parts pass through each other. When it is off, they collide again. |
| `Part0` | `BasePart?` | — | read/write | The first of the two parts. |
| `Part1` | `BasePart?` | — | read/write | The second of the two parts. |
